mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_log (vehicle_num, license_plate_country, is_ev_license_plate, entry_time) VALUES (#{vehicleNum}, #{licensePlateCountry}, #{isEvLicensePlate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM parking_log WHERE vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum} AND exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, vehicle_num AS vehicleNum, license_plate_country AS licensePlateCountry, is_ev_license_plate AS isEvLicensePlate, entry_time AS entryTime, exit_time AS exitTime, is_member AS isMember, parking_fee AS parkingFee FROM parking_log WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
